title: 第8章 针锋(1)
content_zh:
“不孝女，还不跪下！”
伴随着沈老夫人的这句话，沈妙却没有动。
众人有些吃惊的看着她，沈信常年征战不在府中，沈妙养在老夫人跟前，沈老夫人待她严厉，沈妙性格被养的懦弱木讷，对老夫人的命令从未有过反驳，今日竟然不跪？
果真是只要有关定王的事，她便生出莫大的勇气么？
“祖母，五娘不知自己何错之有。”沈妙平静的道。
“五妹妹莫非是烧糊涂了不成？”沈玥最先出口，面上带着些焦急的神情：“祖母只是一时气急，并非真的要罚你，如今只要认个错儿便能妥帖的事情，怎么还执拗起来了？”
一句话，便把知错不改，顶撞长辈的罪名扣在了沈妙头上。
“放肆！简直反了天了！”沈老夫人气的一下子坐直了身子，声音带着几分尖利，沈元柏正吃着嘴里的糖蒸酥酪，被沈老夫人这么一吓，手里的点心不小心掉在地上，顿时哇哇大哭起来。
“七哥儿莫哭了，”任婉云见小儿子哭了，立刻几步上前将他抱在怀中，看着沈妙的目光里全是不赞同：“五娘，你是疯了不成，谁教你顶撞的长辈？”
沈妙看向任婉云。
(adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
二夫人任婉云身材丰腴，穿着菘蓝色盘丝云锦长锻衣，面色红润，白白胖胖。，看上去和气又仁善，平日里总是带着笑容，掌家之权握在手中，沈府上上下下都敬她处事公正分明，是个当之无愧的好媳妇儿。
沈妙也曾这么觉得，直到后来，自己出嫁的时候，沈信几乎将自家大半财产都添做了嫁妆，可最后到了定王府，嫁妆却寥寥无几。为什么呢，自然是被任婉云扣下了。
任婉云将嫁妆里值钱的东西扣了下来，店铺也换了主人，沈信又不在京城，自己傻乎乎的嫁到定王府，却因为嫁妆问题受尽了定王府上上下下的白眼。都亏了这位好婶婶的“公正”。
“二婶此言，也是认为五娘做错了？”沈妙轻声道：“可五娘不知道自己哪里做错了。”
“蠢货！”沈老夫人没忍住，当即大骂起来：“你小小年纪不知廉耻，偷看定王殿下，把我们沈府的脸面都丢尽了！还敢与我顶嘴，谁教你的规矩，如此上不得台面！”
沈妙心中微叹。沈老夫人平日里架子拿的十足，可一旦开口，定是歌女作风无疑，哪家高门大户的老夫人会如此破口大骂？简直如三教九流那窑姐儿一般，上辈子沈妙还不觉得，当过皇后以后再看，便觉得与沈老夫人说话都是降低了身份。
“偷看定王殿下？”她歪着头，困惑的问。
沈玥忍不住开口道：“五妹妹，虽然知道你爱慕定王，可是因为偷看定王而让自己掉下水中，实在是有损府上颜面。而且定王殿下定是心中不喜，五妹妹，你还是寻个机会给定王殿下道歉吧。”
爱慕定王，给定王道歉。哪个女人愿意在自己心爱的男人面前失了脸面呢？上辈子，沈玥也是这么说的，沈老夫人深以为然，沈妙觉得难堪抵死不从，便被沈老夫人一怒之下关了禁足。

一句话就是因为爱慕定王而不知廉耻，毁了自己名声还连累府上，沈玥看着温柔典雅，心思却如此叵测，沈妙忍不住看了她一眼。
content_en:
"Unfilial daughter, why don't you kneel down!"
Following Mrs. Shen's words, Shen Miao did not move.
Everyone looked at her with some surprise. Shen Xin was away from the mansion for many years of war. Shen Miao was raised in front of the old lady. Old Shen Madam treated her harshly. Shen Miao was raised to be weak and dull. She never refuted the old lady's orders. Why didn't she kneel today?
Is it true that as long as she has something to do with Prince Ding, she will develop great courage?
"Grandma, Wu Niang doesn't know what her fault is." Shen Miao said calmly.
"Is it possible that the fifth sister is suffering from a fever?" Shen Yue was the first to speak, with a somewhat anxious look on her face: "Grandma is just angry for a moment, and she doesn't really want to punish you. Why are you so stubborn now that you can just admit your mistake?"
In one sentence, Shen Miao was blamed for not correcting her mistakes and contradicting her elders.
"Presumptuous! It's so outrageous!" Mrs. Shen sat upright angrily, her voice a bit sharp. Shen Yuanbai was eating the steamed cheese with sugar in his mouth. When Mrs. Shen was so frightened, the snack in his hand accidentally fell to the ground, and he burst into tears.
"Seventh brother, please stop crying." Seeing her youngest son crying, Ren Wan Yun immediately stepped forward and held him in her arms. She looked at Shen Miao with disapproval in her eyes: "Fifth Mother, are you crazy? Who taught you to contradict your elders?"
Shen Miao looked at Ren Wanyun.

The second wife, Ren Wanyun, has a plump figure. She wears a long black silk silk brocade dress. She has a rosy complexion and is fair and plump. , looks kind and kind, always smiles on weekdays, holds the power of the family in her hands, everyone in the Shen family respects her for being fair and clear-cut, and she is a well-deserved good daughter-in-law.
Shen Miao also felt this way, until later, when she got married, Shen Xin almost added most of his family's property as dowry, but in the end when he arrived at Prince Ding's palace, there was only very little dowry. Why, it was naturally detained by Ren Wanyun.
Ren Wanyun withheld the valuable items from the dowry, the shop also changed its owner, and Shen Xin was not in the capital. She foolishly married into Prince Ding's Mansion, but because of the dowry issue, she received a lot of looks from everyone in Prince Ding's Mansion. All thanks to this good aunt's "justice".
"Second Aunt said this, does she think Wu Niang did something wrong?" Shen Miao said softly: "But Wu Niang doesn't know what she did wrong."
"Idiot!" Old Mrs. Shen couldn't hold back and immediately yelled: "You are so shameless at such a young age that you peeked at His Highness Prince Ding and brought shame on our Shen family! You dare to talk back to me? Who taught you the rules? You are not worthy of being on the stage like this!"
Shen Miao sighed in her heart. Mrs. Shen was usually very arrogant, but once she opened her mouth, she would act like a showgirl. Which old lady from a wealthy family would curse like this? She was just like the kiln girl from the Three Religions and Nine Schools. In her previous life, Shen Miao didn't feel that, but now that she was a queen, she felt that talking to Mrs. Shen was a sign of lowering her status.
"Peeping at His Highness Prince Ding?" She tilted her head and asked in confusion.
Shen Yue couldn't help but said: "Fifth sister, although I know that you love Prince Ding, but letting yourself fall into the water because you peeked at Prince Ding really harmed the face of the family. And His Highness Prince Ding must be unhappy in his heart. Fifth sister, you'd better find an opportunity to apologize to His Highness Prince Ding."
I admire King Ding and apologize to King Ding. Which woman is willing to lose face in front of the man she loves? In the previous life, Shen Yue also said the same thing, and Mrs. Shen deeply believed it. Shen Miao felt embarrassed and refused to obey, so she was imprisoned and grounded by Mrs. Shen out of anger.
In one sentence, she was shameless because of her love for Prince Ding, which ruined her reputation and even brought trouble to the family. Shen Yue looked gentle and elegant, but her thoughts were so unpredictable that Shen Miao couldn't help but glance at her.
